description: Scope mapping, not feature parity. native means a platform recipe; foundation means an existing UI primitive; planned means unimplemented. No entry is a certified accessibility claim. Proposed names may change.

components.name: Button
components.contract: Use buttons for actions and anchors for navigation; preserve submit, disabled, and accessible names. Native buttons support data-variant primary/secondary/quiet/danger and data-size small/default/large; anchors keep link styling.
components.acceptance: Enter/Space, focus, submitter, loading feedback, and disabled behavior.
components.example: View projects

components.name: Button Group
components.contract: Group related actions; use a labelled group when context needs it. A cluster is not an ARIA toolbar.
components.acceptance: Wrapping, long labels, independent Tab stops; add roving focus only in a separately specified toolbar.
components.example: Cancel

components.name: Copy Button
components.contract: Copy an explicit source on user activation; retain selectable source text and visible feedback.
components.acceptance: Clipboard denial, secure-context availability, repeated activation, and polite success/failure announcements.

components.name: Dropdown
components.contract: Separate navigation disclosures from command menus. Only enhanced command lists receive menu roles.
components.acceptance: Arrows, Home/End, typeahead, Escape, focus return, outside dismissal, and nested ownership.

components.name: Dropdown Item
components.contract: Keep native actions and destinations; define checkable items and submenu ownership before adding them.
components.acceptance: Disabled items, checked state, activation, and focus after item removal.

components.name: Checkbox
components.contract: Keep label, name, value, checked, required, and disabled on the native input.
components.acceptance: Space toggles; indeterminate is separate from checked; field errors remain associated.

components.name: Checkbox Group
components.contract: Use a fieldset for a shared question and native checkboxes for independent values.
components.acceptance: Legend announcement, group hint/error association; group minimum-count rules require application validation.
components.example:
<fieldset>
  <legend>Formats</legend>
  <label><input type="checkbox" name="format" value="pdf"> PDF</label>
  <label><input type="checkbox" name="format" value="html"> HTML</label>
</fieldset>

components.name: Color Picker
components.contract: Retain native color input as baseline; richer swatches and text formats are an enhancement.
components.acceptance: Keyboard swatches, explicit color values, alpha/format rules, invalid text, and non-color cues.

components.name: Combobox
components.contract: Start with single selection, explicit filtering rules, and a native successful form control.
components.acceptance: APG keyboard model, active descendant, IME composition, no results, async races, and reset.

components.name: Date Input
components.contract: Use native ISO form values and browser date entry. A custom segmented editor is a later enhancement.
components.acceptance: Locale display, min/max, optional empty values, invalid partial entry, and reset; no custom segment parity claimed.

components.name: Date Picker
components.contract: Calendar enhancement uses an existing date input as value owner; single date precedes ranges.
components.acceptance: Calendar keyboard navigation, month/year announcements, unavailable days, locale, and focus return.

components.name: File Input
components.contract: Keep the native picker, label, multiple/accept hints, and application upload lifecycle.
components.acceptance: Keyboard selection, cancellation, validation, selected-file feedback, and upload failure; accept is not server validation.

components.name: Input
components.contract: Use the correct native type, autocomplete, inputmode, label, and name. Optional data-size small/default/large selects CSS geometry; native size semantics and form ownership remain unchanged.
components.acceptance: Autofill, native validation, descriptions, read-only/disabled, reset, and mobile keyboard.
components.example:
<ui-field>
  <label for="email">Email</label>
  <input id="email" name="email" type="email" autocomplete="email" required>
</ui-field>

components.name: Known Date
components.contract: Compose day, month, and year inputs for dates users know; preserve a labelled group and server parsing.
components.acceptance: Locale order, leap days, partial values, numeric entry, grouped errors, and autofill.

components.name: Number Input
components.contract: Use for quantities, retaining native min/max/step; identifiers remain text inputs.
components.acceptance: Keyboard stepping, decimals, invalid entry, wheel interaction, labels, and reset.
components.example:
<label for="quantity">Quantity</label>
<input id="quantity" name="quantity" type="number" min="1" step="1" value="1">

components.name: OTP Input
components.contract: Default to one input with autocomplete=one-time-code; visual segments must not fragment entry.
components.acceptance: Paste, autofill, leading zeroes, backspace, mobile input, and no forced submission.

components.name: Radio Group
components.contract: Group same-name native radios; ui-form coordinates a single required-group error.
components.acceptance: Arrow navigation, shared name, legend, required state, disabled choices, and reset.
components.example:
<fieldset>
  <legend>Visibility</legend>
  <label><input type="radio" name="visibility" value="private" checked> Private</label>
  <label><input type="radio" name="visibility" value="team"> Team</label>
</fieldset>

components.name: Radio
components.contract: A choice is a native radio with an explicit label and stable value.
components.acceptance: Checked/unchecked state, label activation, group membership, and accessible name.

components.name: Rating
components.contract: Use a labelled radio scale for input and readable text for a display-only rating.
components.acceptance: Keyboard choice, clear/unrated state, numeric text, disabled/read-only, and form reset.

components.name: Select
components.contract: Native options remain the default; searchable choices belong to the separate combobox contract. Optional data-size small/default/large selects CSS geometry; native size semantics and form ownership remain unchanged.
components.acceptance: Arrow/typing behavior, multiple selection, placeholder validity, padding, zoom, and forced colors.

components.name: Option
components.contract: Use native children of select; do not place custom elements inside a traditional select.
components.acceptance: Disabled options, selected state, group labels, value serialization, and reset.

components.name: Slider
components.contract: Supply a label, range constraints, and a textual value with units; do not infer a value announcement from position.
components.acceptance: Arrow/step interaction, min/max, accessible value text, touch, and reset.
components.example:
<label for="volume">Volume, percent</label>
<input id="volume" name="volume" type="range" min="0" max="100" value="50">

components.name: Switch
components.contract: Use only for an immediate binary setting; retain the successful native checkbox and a stable label.
components.acceptance: Space, role/state consistency, pending/failure rollback, and distinction from a submitted checkbox.

components.name: Tag Input
components.contract: Define repeated native form values and removable tokens; baseline accepts a documented text format.
components.acceptance: IME, delimiters, duplicates, keyboard removal, accessible removal names, and reset.

components.name: Textarea
components.contract: Preserve native multiline editing, resize, name, maxlength, and associated descriptions. Optional data-size small/default/large selects CSS geometry; native size semantics and form ownership remain unchanged.
components.acceptance: Newlines, paste, zoom, error recovery, read-only, disabled, and reset.

components.name: Time Input
components.contract: Use native normalized form values; locale formatting stays with the browser initially.
components.acceptance: Seconds/step, min/max, optional emptiness, mobile entry, and server timezone policy.

components.name: Accordion
components.contract: Start with native disclosures; grouped single-open behavior must be optional and preserve readable fallback.
components.acceptance: Summary keyboard use, headings, multi/single-open policy, deep links, and focus in collapsed content.

components.name: Accordion Item
components.contract: Keep the native disclosure as the item; no replacement custom button is needed for the baseline.
components.acceptance: Accessible summary, open state, nested interactive content, and heading structure.

components.name: Card
components.contract: A panel supplies a surface; native children supply meaning. Explicit links and buttons remain separate.
components.acceptance: Heading structure, repeated link names, focus, long content; no clickable-card nesting traps.

components.name: Details
components.contract: Use the browser disclosure for optional content; closed content must not contain required instructions.
components.acceptance: Enter/Space, open state, link targets, print policy, and nested disclosure behavior.

components.name: Dialog
components.contract: Use an accessible title, explicit close action and browser modal behavior. Application code opens it, clears stale results and retains inline information when enhancement is unavailable. Long structured content starts with heading focus and scrolls as one native surface. See docs/dialog.md and its long-briefing recipe.
components.acceptance: Browser assertions cover short/long modal focus, scroll bounds, both close actions, reopening at the start, background focus blocking, close results, return focus after trigger changes and unsupported/open-failure/no-script fallback. Verify remaining browser/mobile, zoom, forced colors, touch and screen-reader combinations before release; see dated manual evidence in ACCESSIBILITY.md.

components.name: Divider
components.contract: Use hr for a thematic break and CSS for presentation-only boundaries.
components.acceptance: Meaning in reading order, contrast where essential, and forced-colors visibility.

components.name: Drawer
components.contract: Define modal and non-modal modes separately; modal drawer builds on native dialog.
components.acceptance: Escape, focus trapping only in modal mode, return focus, edge placement in RTL, and reduced motion.

components.name: Page
components.contract: Compose header/nav/main/aside/footer; existing primitives supply arrangement without implied landmarks.
components.acceptance: Skip link, one main landmark, responsive reading order, long navigation, and print.

components.name: Scroller
components.contract: Current baseline wraps wide tables with an explicitly named focusable region; general scrolling affordances remain planned.
components.acceptance: Keyboard scrolling, visible overflow cues, 320px reflow, focus outline, and touch.

components.name: Split Panel
components.contract: Use a keyboard-operable separator with labelled controlled panes and resilient static-layout fallback.
components.acceptance: Arrow resizing, min/max, aria-valuenow, collapse/restore, RTL, touch, and persistence ownership.

components.name: Breadcrumb
components.contract: Use a named navigation landmark and ordered destination links; final location is clearly current.
components.acceptance: Current-page announcement, truncation alternatives, long labels, and separators hidden from assistive technology.

components.name: Breadcrumb Item
components.ui: li containing a or current text
components.contract: Each item remains a real list item and destination or current-page text.
components.acceptance: Correct href, unique link purpose, and aria-current on one current location.
components.example: • Projects

components.name: Pagination
components.contract: Use real URLs as baseline; application owns data loading and total counts.
components.acceptance: Current page, previous/next boundaries, ellipses as text, focus after update, and no-JS navigation.

components.name: Stepper
components.contract: Show process progress; link only to reachable steps. This is not a tablist.
components.acceptance: Current step via aria-current=step, completed/error text, linear workflow, and narrow-screen reading order.

components.name: Step
components.contract: Each step supplies a visible name and textual state; inactive destinations are not fake disabled links.
components.acceptance: Meaningful state announcement, allowed navigation, and validation errors on return.

components.name: Tab Group
components.contract: Enhance readable linked sections only when ready; manual activation is the default for slow panels.
components.acceptance: Arrows/Home/End, selected/tabindex state, panel relationships, deep links, and focus on removal.

components.name: Tab
components.contract: Keep a real fragment destination before enhancement; tab semantics and keyboard behavior arrive together.
components.acceptance: Active-only Tab entry, focus versus selection, Enter/Space, and orientation/RTL.

components.name: Tab Panel
components.contract: Sections remain readable without scripts; enhanced inactive panels leave the focus order.
components.acceptance: Label/control IDs, lazy content readiness, no hidden focused controls, and hash navigation.

components.name: Tree
components.contract: Reserve explorer semantics for actual hierarchical selection; ordinary navigation stays a disclosure list.
components.acceptance: Visible-node arrows, Home/End, typeahead, single selection, expansion versus activation, and dynamic removal.

components.name: Tree Item
components.ui: li with native actions inside ui-tree (proposed)
components.contract: Only branches expand; focused, selected, and activated states remain distinct.
components.acceptance: Parent/child relationships, level/position when needed, leaf semantics, and labelled action access.

components.name: Badge
components.contract: Use readable status/count text; appearance is secondary and does not imply a live announcement.
components.acceptance: Non-color meaning, contrast, adjacent naming, and large/localized counts.

components.name: Callout
components.contract: Persistent inline information with visible heading; use live roles only for newly occurring messages.
components.acceptance: Heading/link purpose, status text, optional dismissal, focus after removal, and announcement restraint.

components.name: Progress Bar
components.contract: Use value/max for measurable progress and omit value for indeterminate work.
components.acceptance: Accessible name, actual value, completion/failure text, and announcement throttling.

components.name: Progress Ring
components.contract: Keep one semantic native progress control and add a visual ring without duplicate announcements.
components.acceptance: Determinate/indeterminate, textual value, forced colors, reduced motion, and no duplicate progress roles.

components.name: Skeleton
components.contract: Decorative placeholder accompanies one named busy content region; avoid hiding actual loaded content.
components.acceptance: aria-hidden placeholder, aria-busy lifecycle, stable geometry, reduced motion, and failure exit.

components.name: Spinner
components.contract: Expose concise loading text once; animation must not be the only indication.
components.acceptance: Reduced motion, duplicate announcement prevention, stuck/error state, and label visibility.

components.name: Tag
components.ui: ui-tag with optional native remove button (proposed)
components.contract: Readable category/selection text with explicit action when removable; no implied button role on static tags.
components.acceptance: Remove name includes the tag, focus after removal, long text, and state contrast.

components.name: Toast
components.contract: Use one notification region; actionable or important messages persist and also have durable context.
components.acceptance: Announcement queue, no focus theft, pause/dismiss policy, reduced motion, and visible history for important results.

components.name: Toast Item
components.ui: native content and button in ui-toasts (proposed)
components.contract: Keep concise text and clearly named actions; automatic dismissal is not the sole delivery of important information.
components.acceptance: Live politeness, repeated messages, dismissal focus, and async action failure.

components.name: Tooltip
components.contract: Use for supplemental non-interactive descriptions; essential help remains visible and interactive content uses a popover.
components.acceptance: Keyboard focus, Escape, hoverable/persistent content, touch alternative, and aria-describedby ownership.

components.name: Animated Image
components.contract: Supply still image fallback and an explicit play/pause control; avoid unsolicited motion.
components.acceptance: Alt text, reduced-motion default, pause state, keyboard activation, and loading failure.

components.name: Avatar
components.contract: Support an image or readable initials; repeated adjacent names may make the image decorative.
components.acceptance: Meaningful alt policy, initials fallback, image failure, and no color-only identity.

components.name: Carousel
components.contract: Readable list is the baseline. Start without autoplay and keep all slide destinations available.
components.acceptance: Keyboard controls, slide names, focus stability, hidden-slide focus, swipe alternatives, and reduced motion.

components.name: Carousel Item
components.contract: Keep a slide heading and semantic content; visibility is enhancement-owned.
components.acceptance: Accessible position, active state, focus after removal, and media pause when hidden.

components.name: Comparison
components.contract: Present both labelled originals before enhancement and retain separate links to each image.
components.acceptance: Keyboard range control, before/after descriptions, touch, zoom, and non-visual comparison text.

components.name: Icon
components.contract: Use a curated SVG contract; icons are decorative unless they independently carry meaning.
components.acceptance: Decorative aria-hidden, meaningful accessible name, currentColor, forced colors, and visible labels for unfamiliar actions.

components.name: Markdown
components.contract: Prefer build/server rendering; optional client parser must define sanitized output and safe URL policy.
components.acceptance: Unsafe HTML/URLs, semantic headings, code escaping, fetch failure if supported, and dependency review.

components.name: QR Code
components.contract: Render a code alongside its readable destination; scanning is never the only route.
components.acceptance: Destination link, accessible label, contrast, export, encoding failure, and external-library budget.

components.name: Video
components.contract: Native player is the baseline; verified captions, transcript, and necessary descriptions are required before publishing a complete media example.
components.acceptance: Keyboard playback, captions, transcript link, no autoplay, and platform control testing; legacy assets are not yet verified.
components.example: Read the transcript
components.exampleNote: Illustrative structure only: media assets and captions must be supplied and verified.

components.name: Video Playlist
components.contract: Compose one native player with an ordered list of linked, labelled media entries.
components.acceptance: Current item, captions per item, ended behavior, no forced autoplay, and failure recovery.

components.name: Zoomable Frame
components.contract: Give embedded content a title and direct link; keep zoom controls outside the embedded document.
components.acceptance: Keyboard zoom/pan, reset, escape from interaction mode, cross-origin boundaries, and mobile reflow.

components.name: Bar Chart
components.contract: Use a figure and a real data table as source/fallback; bars supplement values.
components.acceptance: Category/series labels, zero baseline policy, non-color encoding, table equivalence, and high contrast.

components.name: Bubble Chart
components.contract: Describe all three dimensions with units and preserve the underlying records in a table.
components.acceptance: Size legend, accessible data access, keyboard inspection where interactive, and meaningful summary.

components.name: Data Grid
components.contract: Ship table sorting/filtering first; only spreadsheet interaction earns the ARIA grid model. Defer virtualization.
components.acceptance: Header associations, aria-sort, cell navigation contract, editing escape, selection, and large-data assistive technology tests.

components.name: Doughnut Chart
components.contract: Keep part/whole totals in a table and visible text; limit categories and provide a comparison alternative.
components.acceptance: Labels/totals, non-color identification, small slices, and equivalent table reading order.

components.name: Line Chart
components.contract: Use labelled temporal/ordered axes, units, textual trend summary, and underlying table.
components.acceptance: Missing-value policy, series identification without color, keyboard data access, and reduced motion.

components.name: Pie Chart
components.contract: Treat as optional presentation over a part/whole table; prefer bars for close comparisons.
components.acceptance: Labels, percentages/totals, color independence, and readable alternative.

components.name: Polar Area Chart
components.contract: Require a reason for radial presentation; keep common scale and table values explicit.
components.acceptance: Scale explanation, text equivalent, category order, and non-color encodings.

components.name: Radar Chart
components.contract: Document normalized axes and keep comparable values available as a table.
components.acceptance: Axis/scale labels, overlap handling, series identification, and alternative comparison.

components.name: Scatter Chart
components.contract: Describe units and relationship; preserve individual values and selected-point context.
components.acceptance: Keyboard inspection, dense data strategy, clear axes, and equivalent tabular access.

components.name: Sparkline
components.contract: Pair compact trend graphics with a concise textual change summary and data link.
components.acceptance: Name, trend meaning, no essential hover-only details, forced colors, and inline sizing.

components.name: Chart / Advanced Usage
components.contract: Choose a rendering dependency only after table-first, theming, and accessibility contracts are proven.
components.acceptance: Shared data schema, table parity, resize, teardown, theme updates, and dependency/license review.

components.name: Animation
components.contract: Use CSS/Web Animations API with an explicit reduced-motion contract; content remains readable without animation.
components.acceptance: Cancel/finish lifecycle, no flashing, reduced motion, and motion-independent state changes.

components.name: Format Bytes
components.contract: Choose explicit byte/bit and decimal/binary units; preserve readable server text.
components.acceptance: Locale, unit labels, zero/negative/invalid values, and deterministic updates.

components.name: Format Date
components.contract: Keep machine-readable datetime and server-rendered text; use Intl with explicit locale/timezone policy.
components.acceptance: Invalid dates, hydration consistency, timezone, locale change, and no layout-dependent meaning.

components.name: Format Number
components.contract: Use Intl with explicit currency/unit options while keeping a readable fallback value.
components.acceptance: Locale, rounding, invalid input, currency ambiguity, and stable server/client values.

components.name: Include
components.contract: Prefer server includes; optional client loading requires an explicit trusted-origin and sanitization contract.
components.acceptance: Loading/failure fallback, duplicate IDs, script execution policy, cancellation, and offline behavior.

components.name: Intersection Observer
components.contract: Expose observation only when repeated product needs justify markup; no essential content depends on visibility callbacks.
components.acceptance: Unobserve on disconnect, reconnect once, unsupported API fallback, and nested-root ownership.

components.name: Mutation Observer
components.contract: Keep internal observation private by default; optional declarative adapter must avoid self-triggered loops.
components.acceptance: Mutation batching, loop protection, teardown, child ownership, and explicit event detail.

components.name: Popover
components.contract: Use native auto popover and declarative invokers for optional non-modal information. Capability/target checks retain complete inline help when enhancement is unavailable. See docs/popover.md; content keeps its native semantics.
components.acceptance: Browser assertions cover toggle/close, non-modal editing, native target relationships, focus restoration, disabled actions, auto-popover coordination, long-content bounds and missing-support/no-script fallback. Verify real Escape, light dismissal, keyboard traversal, zoom, mobile, forced colors and screen readers; see dated evidence in ACCESSIBILITY.md.

components.name: Popup
components.ui: shared positioning utility (proposed; no public element required)
components.contract: Keep low-level positioning separate from semantics; shared layer supports menus, tooltips, and popovers.
components.acceptance: Viewport collision, scrolling, zoom, RTL, cleanup, and native anchor-positioning fallback strategy.

components.name: Random Content
components.contract: Keep nonessential variation deterministic where possible; never randomize required instructions or control order.
components.acceptance: Readable fallback, stable hydration, no repeated focus removal, and predictable refresh.

components.name: Relative Time
components.contract: Retain absolute datetime and readable fallback; relative text must expose an absolute-date alternative.
components.acceptance: Locale, future/past boundaries, update scheduling, timezone, and timer cleanup without live-announcement noise.

components.name: Resize Observer
components.contract: Use CSS container queries for layout first; optional adapter handles actual measurement needs.
components.acceptance: Feedback-loop protection, teardown/reconnect, batching, and unsupported API fallback.

uiComponents.contract: Vertical rhythm for direct children. Default geometry follows comfortable/compact data-density scopes; local component overrides still win. See docs/density.md.
Wrapping row of native controls or content. Default geometry follows comfortable/compact data-density scopes; local component overrides still win. See docs/density.md.
Responsive equal tracks without grid semantics. Default geometry follows comfortable/compact data-density scopes; local component overrides still win. See docs/density.md.
Two direct children: sidebar first, content second. Default geometry follows comfortable/compact data-density scopes; local component overrides still win. See docs/density.md.
Surface/padding without a landmark or interactive role. Default geometry follows comfortable/compact data-density scopes; local component overrides still win. See docs/density.md.
One native control plus label, hints and error.
Supplemental text, explicitly associated for no-JS use.
uiComponents.example:
<ui-hint id="title-hint">Use a short name.</ui-hint>
<input aria-label="Title" aria-describedby="title-hint" name="title">

uiComponents.contract: Inline text, associated when an error is present.
uiComponents.example:
<ui-error id="title-error">Error: Enter a title</ui-error>
<input aria-label="Title" name="title" aria-invalid="true" aria-describedby="title-error">

uiComponents.contract: Named summary with field links and focus behavior.

Wrap exactly one native form; coordinate validation and recovery. Adopt visible server field errors without moving focus. Observe native external/dynamic ownership; support grouped feedback and application-supplied prefixes/message translations. Async transport remains application-owned; see docs/forms.md.
Native skip anchor with visible focused presentation.
